name: Toyo Logistics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. was established in 1893 in Nagoya and is engaged in logistics management and real estate. It offers global freight forwarding by land, sea and air linking Japan with the world. Port-related services include shipping agency, handling of imported and exported cargo, marine containers and customs brokerage, plus coordination of storage, distribution and packaging for smaller consignments.
